thag6.12:1.1:
Whence is there anger
in one without anger
thag6.12:2.1:
You make things worse
when you flare up
at someone who’s angry.
thag6.12:2.3:
Whoever doesn’t flare up
at someone who’s angry
thag6.12:2.4:
wins a battle
hard to win.
thag6.12:3.1:
You live for the good of both
—your own, the other’s—
when, knowing the other’s provoked,
thag6.12:4.1: When you work the cure of both
thag6.12:4.3: those who think you a fool
thag6.12:6.2:
after sensual pleasures
& states of becoming,
thag6.12:6.4:
as you would a bad ox
eating grain.
